latest_release.name: v1.7.4
latest_release.body:
# Summary
HLS.js v1.7.4 includes bug fixes and improvements over the last release.

## Changes Since The Last Release
https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.4

## Bug fixes and improvements

### Low-latency HLS

- Fix skipping unloaded trailing parts at fragment boundaries (#8055) @darfink
- Advance part loading once all parts of a fragment are loaded (#8134, follow-up to #8055) @robwalch
- Adjust playlist position using first part start PTS (#8105, fixes #8098)
- Fix repeated audio buffer flushing when setting `nextAudioTrack` during Low-Latency HLS part loading (#8104)
- Fix LL-HLS subtitle stall from one-ULP rounding in final-part comparison (#8057, fixes #8051) @akashchamp

### Content protection (DRM / EME)

- Reuse attached `MediaKeys` across `loadSource` (#8095, fixes #8092) @krseager
- Reuse attached `MediaKeys` when `loadSource` re-attaches media, and serialize `setMediaKeys` calls (#8120, fixes #8092) @matvp91
  - Introduces experimental, opt-in only, `reuseKeySessions` configuration option
- Keep pending `setMediaKeys` when the same keys are requested while media is detached (#8076)
- FairPlay Streaming: reset `MediaKeys` when changing the MediaSource (#8131) @robwalch

### Interstitials

- Set a schedule position when interstitial fallback happens with nothing playing (#8088) @Arthur031221
- Trigger `INTERSTITIAL_ENDED` for unresolved interstitials (empty asset-list, or removed from schedule while loading) (#8090, fixes #8082) @robwalch

### Alternate audio

- Prevent loop loading of audio in the next discontinuity (f86f24724) @robwalch
- Complete audio track switch when switching back to the currently playing track (#8093, fixes #8089) @krseager
- Defer main `BUFFER_EOS` while an alternate audio track switch is in progress (#8053) @brandonocasey

### Subtitles & captions (WebVTT / IMSC1)

- Keep frames in IMSC1 clock times and apply `frameRateMultiplier` (#8086) @luantaraschi
- Keep the text before and between nested spans in IMSC1 cues (#8060, fixes #8069)
- Fix IMSC1 and subtitle loading after interstitial media detach, including IMSC1 parsing without a known `initPTS` (#8077) @matvp91
- Make subtitle-stream-controller `tracksBuffered` a sparse array (#8108, follow-up to #8077) @robwalch
- Keep no-break space lines in WebVTT cues (#8061, fixes #5337) @lagudafuadtosin

### Fragment loading & stream controllers

- Fix bytes/bits mismatch in `isFragmentNearlyDownloaded` and handle unknown fragment length (#8097, fixes #8096) @krseager
- Dispatch errors for dependent fragments to ensure reload (#8127, fixes #8118) @robwalch
- Improve writing of all stream controllers' `lastCurrentTime` on tick end (#8116, follow-up to #8115)
- Keep stream controllers `STOPPED` when `stopLoad()` aborts a fragment load (#8125, fixes #8119) @BeyondITL-Mossaddique
- Load the start fragment again when its request is aborted before anything is buffered (#8115, fixes #8109) @b84330808

### MediaSource & buffering

- Mark fragments as gaps on `SourceBuffer` errors (#8045, fixes #8035) @hongjun-bae
- Detach instead of resetting `MediaSource` when the media element switched to another source (#8085, fixes #8073) @lpommers
- Cancel async end-of-stream operation when ended state is no longer true (#8128, fixes #8122) @robwalch

### Playlist loading & parsing

- Do not wait for previously loaded playlist to reload on switch unless stale (#8107, fixes #8091) @robwalch
- Fix parsing of `#EXTINF` durations without digits after the decimal point (#8113, fixes #8112) @Enesuygurs
- Only re-align discontinuity counts forward when merging playlists (#8048) @hongjun-bae

### Demuxing, remuxing & timestamps

- Fix parameter set truncation, a v1.7.0 regression introduced in a03d5b1 (#8049, fixes #8043) @robwalch
- Keep the timing of later progressive chunks of a segment (#8058, fixes #6764) @lagudafuadtosin
- Anchor `initPTS` on video PTS at discontinuities reached in seq
